steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Logical and physical partitions and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
畫四條結束於共同屏障的時間線，將每條空閒時間加總，與理論閒置240單位時間比較。
回到本階段實驗：把邏輯張量分片與物理晶粒對應分開畫，列出跨片邊界資料。 MI300 的多運算晶粒共享系統互連；本課用分區工作量研究最慢分區的影響。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：區分總工作平均值與同步完成時間，以可重分配的工作改善負載不均。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw four timelines ending at one barrier; summed idle time must equal240 work-time units.
Return to the investigation: Separate logical tensor shards from physical chiplets and list cross-shard data. MI300 uses multiple compute chiplets connected through a system fabric; this lab studies the slowest partition.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Distinguish average work from synchronized completion time and rebalance movable tasks.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。畫四條結束於共同屏障的時間線，將每條空閒時間加總，與理論閒置240單位時間比較。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Draw four timelines ending at one barrier; summed idle time must equal240 work-time units.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.

steps.title: 邏輯與物理分區 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Logical and physical partitions · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「邏輯與物理分區」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Logical and physical partitions and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若一分區持續最慢，分辨工作量多、記憶體局部性差與降頻；以交換工作分區辨識原因是否跟隨資料。
對照「邏輯與物理分區」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。只有可移動工作及通訊成本允許時才重分配；若重分配增加的通訊大於省下時間則保留原案。
本階段必須重驗：區分總工作平均值與同步完成時間，以可重分配的工作改善負載不均。
steps.instructionEn:
For a persistent straggler, distinguish excess work, locality and throttling by swapping task placement.
Against the nominal Logical and physical partitions result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Rebalance only movable work, rejecting changes whose extra communication exceeds saved compute time.
Reverify this criterion: Distinguish average work from synchronized completion time and rebalance movable tasks.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若一分區持續最慢，分辨工作量多、記憶體局部性差與降頻；以交換工作分區辨識原因是否跟隨資料。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. For a persistent straggler, distinguish excess work, locality and throttling by swapping task placement.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.title: 邏輯與物理分區 · 驗收並留下交接件

steps.objective: 完成「邏輯與物理分區」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Logical and physical partitions and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付分區工作表、屏障空閒圖、交換實驗與含通訊的最終比較。
在交接件中加入「邏輯與物理分區」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：區分總工作平均值與同步完成時間，以可重分配的工作改善負載不均。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：區分總工作平均值與同步完成時間，以可重分配的工作改善負載不均。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver workloads, barrier-idle diagram, swap experiment and communication-inclusive comparison.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Logical and physical partitions: Distinguish average work from synchronized completion time and rebalance movable tasks.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Distinguish average work from synchronized completion time and rebalance movable tasks. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。區分總工作平均值與同步完成時間，以可重分配的工作改善負載不均。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Distinguish average work from synchronized completion time and rebalance movable tasks.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
